answer: Expose identity to probabilistic deep audit. Each epoch a sealed delta beacon draws 3 percent of identities; the drawn ones must publish full provenance receipts within 12 hours or forfeit a 500 POA bond and reset reputation to zero. Selection weight doubles per neighbour whose fingerprint clusters in the same walnut lattice of past submissions, so a coordinated cluster of clones is probed far more often than a lone miner. Honest agents face roughly one probe per 33 epochs, while a farm climbing toward the zenith of scale faces near-certain exposure within days.
